notes.title: Deathless Death V1.01 Update Announcement
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed known character name and text errors.
[*] Resolved an issue where using the keyboard during the prologue tutorial could cause a progression error.
[*] Fixed a crash issue on certain Mac models when opening the game.
[/list]

[h2]Content Optimization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Manual saves now include the current dialogue progress.
[*] Improved camera movement speed when using the keyboard.
[*] Adjusted background music in Chapter 4's "The Room".
[*] Enhanced visual effects in Chapter 4's "The Memory" scene.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Report Channels[/h2]
If any of the issues mentioned above persist or if you encounter new issues after the update, please report them via: https://jsj.top/f/CTlSyG

notes.title: Completely Free! Story-driven Puzzle Game Deathless Death Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The full version of Deathless Death is finally here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980172/2550a0a02816576a669542386a8722bd37ffaf94.png[/img]

This is a game combining point-and-click puzzles with visual novel elements. You’ll step into the role of a priest, listening to the confessions of four sinners, uncovering past secrets, and delivering your judgment: redeem or condemn.

The game supports both Simplified Chinese and English, is available for Win/Mac, and takes about 2 hours playthrough. It consists of six chapters, and depending on your choices, the story unfolds towards one of six different endings.

Deathless Death originated as a demo created two years ago for a Game Jam. After completing the initial version, we were busy with studies and life. Two years later, looking back at the project with fresh perspectives and new skills, we collectively decided to go beyond polishing the original and instead replan the development process, resetting the project to realize the story and themes to the fullest of our current abilities.

In this full release, we’ve upgraded the visuals and music, added substantial new story content, and made many adjustments and guides based on feedback from our recent launch event. Ultimately—we chose to present the game for free, hoping it will reach and resonate with even more players. If you enjoy our game, please feel free to share it with your friends!

If you encounter any issues while playing or have any suggestions, please feel free to contact us through the following channels:
[list]
[*] - X: [url=https://x.com/DreamDelivCtr]DreamDelivCtr[/url]
[*] - Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/mEUkzz6qKQ]https://discord.gg/mEUkzz6qKQ[/url]
[/list]
